dedupe_keys.name: structured dataset of daily electricity demand generation load shedding and supply constraints in bangladesh 2019 2024

description: Researchers at the Islamic University of Technology turn 1,867 BPDB daily reports into structured electricity-system records for Bangladesh. Coverage runs from 21 November 2019 to 30 December 2024 at national and divisional scales. Five processing stages retain raw extraction, cleaned records, calendar features, imputation and smoothed model-ready values. Each stage has an Excel workbook; a text README and a separate column-description workbook document the process. Mendeley Data publishes the collection with free access under CC BY 4.0. The deposit does not include the original extraction scripts. Interpolation and centred rolling-median corrections alter some observations, so users should select a processing stage suited to their forecasting or disruption analysis. Files were not downloaded to check those transformations. The daily series complement data-bangladesh-pgcb-hourly-dispatch and data-bangladesh-daily-plant-generation-outages, which have different compilers and coverage. Round 1 rejected the article during a digital-sector search; its documented energy-modelling reuse justifies reopening it.
